purpose: Subsequent temporal confirmation on new full calendar dates of the same die-casting release; not an independent plant. Internal locked specification. The earlier 20-date external test result was already known when this check was designed.
locked_before: Inspecting or summarizing any field value of passorfail on dates after 2019-03-12, and before scoring these dates. Only timestamps, file identity and non-label prefix equivalence were inspected for provenance. Any public overall prevalence is not a day-specific label summary.

eligibility: Keep every eligible released binary-labeled shot on complete observed dates strictly after 2019-03-12. The dated full source has 19 such dates with 17306 records before target-eligibility checks. Exclude all March 12 records from this check to prevent shared dates with the initial evaluation. Exclude no complete date based on labels. Record missing or invalid labels and do not infer them. If all outcomes are unavailable or no defects occur, report this outcome.
model: Reuse exactly the same 2048-record earlier fit, features, transformations, gates, coefficients and all model settings as for the first external casting test; no refitting on its 20 test dates and no tuning. A deterministic reconstruction solely from the original training rows is acceptable only if score identity on the first 26916 evaluation records is verified before evaluation. Verify source identity and confirm that the feature names, ordering and label coding agree across both files; if the prefix labels of the two casting files conflict, do not evaluate the later labels until the discrepancy is explained. Previously used evaluation records can be checked solely for source agreement.
evaluation: Freeze scores for all candidate records on the 19 dates before reading their evaluation outcomes. Rank within each date. Use the previously specified 10% Hamilton inspection quota; base quota counts on the same binary-target eligibility rule as in the first test. Primary contrast remains coupled minus matched four-PC RBF, same stable chronological tie rules. Report counts, recall, defect-positive days reached, eligible days/counts, daily differences, the uncoupled and logistic and chronology controls. Use the same secondary five-day circular block bootstrap of defects per 100 inspections, and an alternative running quota if readily reproducible. Keep this result separate from the 20-day external analysis and from the original ProBayes cohort. No source substitution and no model or window changes after inspection.
independence: This check was motivated by discovery of a strictly longer public file. The first 73612 records matched the previously locked mirror in every non-label field in order. Results in either direction and null results are retained. Selection of the future window used only the end date of the earlier source.
